findings.title: Rounded, category-wide type lookup can reuse the wrong foundation type
findings.body: The generated type name rounds both dimensions to whole millimetres, then searches every structural-foundation family by name alone. Distinct CAD dimensions within the same rounded millimetre can therefore share a type with incorrect dimensions, and a pre-existing symbol from another family with the same type name can be selected without validating its Length and Width values. Scope reuse to the selected base family and verify exact parameter dimensions, or use an exact collision-resistant key.

findings.title: Any closed polyline is silently converted into a rectangular foundation
findings.body: The parser validates only that a polyline is closed. Triangular, L-shaped, curved-segment approximations, and other irregular closed outlines are accepted and reduced to a longest-edge-aligned bounding rectangle. This can create foundations that extend outside the CAD outline and silently corrupt the structural layout. Validate that an outline represents a rectangle within tolerance before producing Length and Width, or explicitly support the intended non-rectangular geometry.
